description: Cambridge City Parking Data is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cambridgeshire Insight. Car Parking data for Cambridge City is available from October 2018 to September 2019. Where possible, the data has been formatted using entry entries and exits, duration and time & date. The spreadsheets are available in six month increments, from Oct-18 -Mar-19, and Apr-19-Sept-19. Coverage: Cambridgeshire Insight. The portal files it under the publisher Cambridgeshire Insight. Its tags are Traffic, parking. It offers 11 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-08-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
